verdict.rationale: Workflow Studio is a no-code automation builder, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back workflows is a fair question for this product. The evidence only says workflows can be built, maintained and updated; it never mentions workflow versions, change review, history, or rollback. Being able to update a workflow is an adjacent capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
